candidate_relations.reason: Hidradenoma papilliferum is a separate benign apocrine neoplasm (typically vulvar/perianal) distinct from syringocystadenoma papilliferum (SCAP). The histology here shows a circumscribed tumor contiguous with epidermis, papillary projections with plasma cell–rich stroma, and in situ carcinomatous foci — classic for SCACPIS in SCAP. The candidate names a different tumor subtype and omits the in situ malignant transformation, the SCAP precursor, and the macular amyloidosis component.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Hidradenoma papilliferum is a distinct apocrine tumor entity; the reference specifies syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum in situ arising in syringocystadenoma papilliferum plus macular amyloidosis — a different tumor type, malignant transformation context, precursor lesion, and associated finding
